{{Quotation|game|Previously the site of a floating temple known as [[Kuan Jun]], the [[Harvest Temple]], the '''Unwaking Waters''' is an immense, frozen whirlpool. When the [[Jade Wind]]s passed over [[Cantha]] and Kuan Jun sunk beneath the ocean's surface, the whirlpool was formed, and like everything else in the path of the winds, became solid jade. Legends say a [[Kuunavang|powerful dragon]] was trapped within the temple and lives there still.}}

==Getting there==
The quest [[Into the Whirlpool]] leads players here. Alternatively, [[Gatekeeper Dedrick]] in [[Unwaking Waters (explorable area)]] may bring players here providing that the entire party has completed [[Befriending the Kurzicks]].
